text:
Can you name all 5 main structures of the cavernous sinus? 🧠 Oh, COAT
Cavernous sinus mnemonic: Oh, COAT = 5 main structures
O = Oculomotor nerve (CN III)
C = Internal Carotid artery
O = Ophthalmic nerve (V1)
A = Abducens nerve (CN VI)
T = Trochlear nerve (CN IV)
Inside the sinus: C + A. In the lateral wall, top to bottom: III, IV, V1.
Quick test: which cranial nerve runs inside the sinus, beside the artery? Answer in the video.
Save this for your next anatomy exam.
Images: Gray's Anatomy (1918), Fig. 786, public domain; diagrams: Book Plume
